key_insight: VASPO combines a critic and a self-teacher at the same student-generated prefixes, using value-based PPO advantages plus bounded teacher scaling to better align self-distillation with expected return.
engineering_relevance: The method offers a practical reinforcement-learning recipe for improving mathematical reasoning models by stabilizing updates and exploiting complementary token-position signals from privileged information.
method: Critic predicts continuation returns from privileged information and converts them into token-level PPO advantages.
Self-teacher modulates selected positive advantages using bounded probability ratios.
Integration is done within PPO rather than GRPO, leveraging complementary positional dynamics across generation.
evidence_signal: Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks, VASPO improves mean accuracy over PPO by 2.59 points on Qwen3-4B and 1.81 points on OLMo3-7B, and achieves the best mean accuracy on Knights and Knaves.
watch_item: Performance depends on a critic accurate near the end of responses and careful bounding of teacher ratios; mismatched value estimates or overly aggressive scaling could destabilize training.
paper_title: VASPO: Self-Distillation with Privileged Value Estimation
